📢 PAID INTERNSHIP OPPORTUNITY

Alteram Legal Agency is currently looking for a Paid Internship – Legal Team for female students who are interested in gaining experience in the legal field.

📍 Location: Yogyakarta (Offline)

Qualifications:

Female, active university student (minimum 6th semester)

Own vehicle and laptop

Able to work offline in Yogyakarta

Able to work in a team

High initiative and presentable

Benefits:
💰 Pocket money
🎁 Monthly bonus
📦 Interns kit

🔗 Registration Link:
https://bit.ly/ALTInternship0425

Don't miss this opportunity to gain valuable experience and develop your skills in the legal field!
